## 1. Build, Lint, Test and Coverage

`composer ci:check` is the CI gate (`.github/workflows/tests.yml`). It chains `npm run lint:check`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run types:check`, `npm test`, then `composer test`. Run it before declaring work done.

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `composer ci:check` | Full CI gate — JS lint + format + types + Vitest, then `composer test` |
| `composer setup` | One-shot bootstrap: composer install, copy .env, key:generate, migrate --force, npm install, npm run build |
| `composer dev` | Run the app dev stack (`@php artisan dev`) |
| `npm run dev` | Vite dev server |
| `npm run build` | `vite build` — mandatory after any CSS/JS/Blade Tailwind change |
| `npm run build:ssr` | `vite build && vite build --ssr` |
| `php artisan test` | Pest suite (Unit + Feature) |
| `php artisan test --compact` | Agent-preferred test invocation; add `--filter=Name` to narrow |
| `composer test` | `config:clear` + `lint:check` + `types:check` + `php artisan test` |
| `npm run test` | `vitest run` (canvas + prancheta TS modules) |
| `npm run test:watch` | `vitest` in watch mode |
| `composer lint` | `pint --parallel` (writes) |
| `composer lint:check` | `pint --parallel --test` (read-only) |
| `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` | Agent-mandated PHP format pass before finalizing edits |
| `composer types:check` | `phpstan analyse` (Larastan level 7) |
| `npm run lint` / `npm run lint:check` | `eslint . --fix` / `eslint .` |
| `npm run format` / `npm run format:check` | `prettier --write resources/` / `prettier --check resources/` |
| `npm run types:check` | `vue-tsc --noEmit` |
| `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed --force` | CI database prep |
| `php artisan db:seed --class=CatalogSeeder` | Reseed the read-only catalog |

Coverage: none. CI sets `coverage: none`; no coverage tool or script exists in any manifest.

## 2. Code Style & Project Conventions

Authoritative hand-written sources — read them, do not duplicate or contradict them: `.ai/rules/index.md` (glob → rule-file map, 15 files) and `.ai/guidelines/php-laravel.md`.

### Enforced by tooling

| Rule | Enforcement |
| --- | --- |
| PHP formatting: Laravel preset | `pint.json`, `composer lint:check` in `composer ci:check` |
| Static analysis level 7, no baseline, no ignoreErrors; paths `app/`, `bootstrap/app.php`, `config/`, `database/`, `routes/` | `phpstan.neon`, `composer types:check` |
| ESLint 9 flat config: vue essential, `vueTsConfigs.recommended`, `@stylistic`, import ordering, prettier compat | `eslint.config.js`, `npm run lint:check` |
| Prettier: 4-space, single quotes, printWidth 80, Tailwind class sorting (`clsx`/`cn`/`cva`) | `.prettierrc`, `npm run format:check` |
| TS types must pass `vue-tsc --noEmit` | `tsconfig.json`, `npm run types:check` |
| Generated dirs excluded from lint: `resources/js/{actions,routes,wayfinder}/**`, `resources/js/components/ui/*`, `vendor`, `public`, `bootstrap/ssr` | `eslint.config.js` ignores |
| Stack versions (Inertia 3, Vue 3, Laravel 13, PHP 8.4) are pinned | `tests/Feature/StackContractTest.php`, `tests/Feature/DeliveryContractTest.php` |

### PHP / Laravel

- Domain concepts are **lookup tables, not Enums**. No migration creates an `enum` column; no model casts a domain attribute to an Enum. See `database/migrations/` and `database/seeders/`.
- No PHP enum exists in `app/`. Generic "use an Enum" advice never justifies creating one where the schema defined a lookup row.
- Comments: PHPDoc `/** */` only above classes/methods. Never `//`, `#`, or `/* */` directly above a declaration. Inside method bodies comment WHY, never WHAT.
- Services live in `app/Services/`, carry no presentation logic (no views/redirects/flash), and take `request()`/`session()`/`auth()` values as parameters. Inject per-method when used once, via constructor when used in several methods.
- One class, one reason to change. Single-purpose Services/Actions. No interface for a single implementation with no second in sight.
- Models: `$fillable` stays in sync with migrations; conventional relationship names with correct return types (`HasMany`, `BelongsTo`, …); every relationship's inverse defined; explicit FKs when non-conventional. Modern attribute style is in use — `#[Fillable]`, `#[UsePolicy]`, `#[Scope]`, `#[ScopedBy]`, `#[ObservedBy]` (`app/Models/`).
- Laravel style: helpers over facades (`auth()->id()`, `redirect()->route()`, `str()->slug()`), no `::query()` before `create()`, no `whereKey()`, `match` over `switch`, `is_null()` over `=== null`.
- Never chain two migration-creating artisan commands with `&&` — identical timestamps.
- Per-user isolation has two locks: owner-scoped route binding (`AppServiceProvider::configureRouteBindings()`, 404 before the controller) plus `Gate::authorize` per action (`app/Http/Controllers/TrainingSessionController.php`). `user_id` never comes from the client and is never exposed by a Resource (`.ai/rules/controllers.md`, `.ai/rules/resources.md`).
- Catalog tables are seeder-only at runtime — `app/Concerns/ReadOnlyAtRuntime.php` throws `RuntimeException` on save/delete outside console.
- Request validation: `prepareForValidation()` normalizes before rules; catalog values validated with `Rule::in` over slugs, never `Rule::exists` (`app/Http/Requests/TrainingSessionUpdateRequest.php`, `.ai/rules/requests.md`).

### Frontend

- Inertia **v3** + Vue 3. Never downgrade to Inertia 2 — it breaks the bootstrap (`resources/views/app.blade.php` uses v3 component syntax; `.ai/rules/general.md`).
- No Livewire. Blade-specific rules (`@session`, `@selected`, `@checked`, `Route::view`, "no single-method view controller") do not apply: every screen is `Inertia::render`.
- Pages in `resources/js/pages/`, shared pieces in `resources/js/components/` and `resources/js/layouts/`. One root element per Vue component.
- `resources/js/canvas/` and `resources/js/prancheta/` are framework-free TypeScript: no Vue imports, no `document`/`window` (swept by a PHP test). `CanvasEngine` is used as `reactive(new CanvasEngine())`, so use TS `private`, never `#private` (`.ai/rules/canvas.md`).
- Business logic stays server-side (Controller → Service); `.vue` files bind, validate, present.
- `data-testid` is the cross-phase contract; all user warnings go through the single toast host (`vue-sonner`); board theme (`sd-theme`/`data-theme`) is separate from the starter kit's `useAppearance` (`.ai/rules/prancheta.md`).
- Every stage gesture goes through `resources/js/composables/useStageInteraction.ts`; hit-testing by `data-*` attributes (`.ai/rules/composables.md`).
- `resources/css/prancheta.css` carries the prototype palette under the `sd-` prefix; light/dark blocks stay identical; the starter kit `--accent` was renamed `--ui-accent` (`.ai/rules/css.md`).

### Tests

- Pest only. No PHPUnit-style test classes. Create with `php artisan make:test --pest {name}`.
- `RefreshDatabase` applies to all of `tests/Feature` via `tests/Pest.php`. The catalog seed is **not** global — any test hitting `/prancheta` must call `seedCatalog()` (`.ai/rules/feature.md`).
- Inertia pages are tested as HTTP feature tests with `Inertia\Testing\AssertableInertia`; assert `assertSessionHasOldInput()` on error redirects.
- Consolidate 2+ same-body scenarios into Pest datasets with descriptive keys; never a dataset for a single case.
- `tests/Feature/Frontend/*Test.php` are PHP tests that read `resources/js/**` as text and cross-check Vitest test names, canvas constants and CSS tokens. Editing TS or CSS can turn the PHP suite red.

Full guidelines: [docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md](docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md).

## 3. Agent Communication & Behavioral Guidelines

- Read `.ai/rules/index.md` first, open every rule file whose glob covers the paths in scope, and run `grep -rin 'keyword' .ai/rules` before writing code.
- Be concise. Report facts and file paths; skip narration of obvious steps.
- Record durable project rules with Laravel Boost `record-rule` (shared, committed) instead of personal notes.

### Never in this repository

- Never create a PHP Enum for a domain concept — the schema defines lookup tables (`database/migrations/`, `.ai/guidelines/php-laravel.md`).
- Never downgrade Inertia 3 to 2, and never add Livewire — versions are pinned by `tests/Feature/StackContractTest.php`.
- Never switch test runners on your own: the gate runs `composer ci:check` / `php artisan test`; a different runner is green for you and red for CI.
- Never mix host and container commands in one flow. Host is the default; inside Sail prefix every command with `./vendor/bin/sail`. Exception: `php artisan boost:install` always runs on the host.
- Never write pipeline or hand-authored prose inside `<laravel-boost-guidelines>…</laravel-boost-guidelines>` in `CLAUDE.md` — `php artisan boost:install` rewrites that block. Durable guidance lives in `.ai/guidelines/php-laravel.md` and `.ai/rules/`.
- Never edit `.ai/rules/**` or `.ai/guidelines/php-laravel.md` wholesale — they are hand-written and authoritative.
- Never import Vue or touch `document`/`window` from `resources/js/canvas/**` — a PHP test sweeps for it (`.ai/rules/canvas.md`).
- Never use `$this->authorizeResource()` in controllers, and never accept `user_id` from the client (`.ai/rules/controllers.md`).
- Never enable the catalog seed globally in tests (`.ai/rules/feature.md`).
- Never finalize PHP edits without `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent`, or frontend edits without `npm run build`.
- Never create documentation files unless explicitly requested.

## 4. Setup, Troubleshooting and Tips

Prereqs: PHP 8.4, Composer, Node 22, npm. MySQL 8 for dev/prod; tests force SQLite `:memory:` (`phpunit.xml`). Choose one track — host-native (default) or Sail/Docker — and never mix them.

Host-native:

```sh
composer install
cp .env.example .env
php artisan key:generate
php artisan migrate --seed
npm install
npm run dev        # separate shell
php artisan serve  # app on :8000
```

Or the scripted equivalent:

```sh
composer setup
```

Optional Sail track (`docker-compose.yml`: PHP 8.4 + mysql:8.0):

```sh
./vendor/bin/sail up -d
./vendor/bin/sail artisan migrate --seed
./vendor/bin/sail npm run dev
```

| Symptom | Check |
| --- | --- |
| `ViteManifestNotFoundException`, ~10 tests red | A failed `npm run build` emptied `public/build` — rerun `npm run build` (`.ai/rules/auth.md`) |
| Board route 500s or renders empty catalog in a test | Test did not call `seedCatalog()` (`.ai/rules/feature.md`) |
| `checks` map comes back reindexed as a list | `TrainingSessionResource` needs `#[PreserveKeys]` (`.ai/rules/resources.md`) |
| Post-auth redirect lands on the wrong page | `fortify.home` and `bootstrap/app.php` `redirectUsersTo` must both say `/prancheta` (`.ai/rules/routes.md`) |
| Seeder passes but a component renders no icon | `components.icon_key` must exist in `resources/js/canvas/icons.ts` (`.ai/rules/seeders.md`) |
| Frontend change invisible in the browser | Run `npm run build`, `npm run dev`, or `composer dev` |
| Two migrations share a timestamp | Migration-creating artisan commands were chained with `&&`; run them one at a time |

Tips:

- Health endpoint: `/up` (`bootstrap/app.php`). `api/*` is forced to JSON exceptions.
- Autosave timing: 800 ms local / 3 s server / 15 s ceiling; clock persists every 20 s (`resources/js/prancheta/autosave.ts`, `clock.ts`).
- Payload limits: 200 nodes / 400 edges (`app/Http/Requests/TrainingSessionUpdateRequest.php`).
- Password reset is intentionally OFF in v1 (`config/fortify.php`); its test is skipped by design.
- No queues, jobs, scheduler or broker — writes are synchronous.
- `resources/js/{actions,routes,wayfinder}/` are Wayfinder build artifacts and gitignored; never hand-edit them.
- Prefer Laravel Boost MCP tools (`database-schema`, `database-query`, `search-docs`) over ad-hoc shell inspection.
